provenance: Bounded independent interpretation of recovered R078 title; not original recovered report.
contract: Actual AVI Hap1 uncompressed BC1 32-frame sequence. Parse container+timestamps, upload BC1 to hardware WebGPU texture and render without VideoDecoder or software video decode. Baseline expands identical BC1 in JS and uploads RGBA. Revised explicit output profile: every RGBA channel <=1/255 error vs independent FFmpeg decode; alpha exact. Prior strict byte-exact profile failed native BC interpolation (171/84 vs170/85), retained separately, no exact claim. Endpoints still exact. Fresh-device nine paired 32-frame jobs including device/pipeline/parser/uploads/readback/cleanup; >=5% median saving and every pair faster. Capability qualification independent of speed. Test native wall-clock scheduling, seeks/source-change/cancel, malformed input and wrong-frame control. No audio, Snappy, variable rate, HDR or physical display qualification.
